name: Final Audit Report Generation
description: After Phase 7 completes, generates a comprehensive FINAL-AUDIT-REPORT.md covering all phases including SonarQube results, then commits and pushes to GitHub

then.prompt:
CHECK: If Phase 7 (Quality Gate) just completed and Phase 8 is now in_progress, generate Migration/FINAL-AUDIT-REPORT.md with:

1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY - overall migration outcome
2. PHASE-BY-PHASE AUDIT:
   - Phase 1: Assessment findings
   - Phase 2: Build config changes
   - Phase 3: Legacy removal (files deleted, files modified)
   - Phase 4: Language features applied
   - Phase 5: Configuration changes
   - Phase 6: Test results
   - Phase 7: SonarQube scan results (gate status, metrics, issues)
3. SONARQUBE RESULTS DETAIL - gate status, coverage, bugs, vulnerabilities, code smells
4. FILES CHANGED - complete list of created/modified/deleted files
5. QUALITY METRICS - before vs after comparison
6. DEVIATIONS - any departures from the plan
7. TIMESTAMP LOG - when each phase completed

After generating the report:
- git add -A
- git commit -m 'migration: Final audit report with SonarQube results'
- git push origin <current-branch>

Update Migration/.migration-state.json Phase 8 to complete.
